Title: Document 4
Content: Source: Jerry Falwell, television evangelist and founder of the Moral Majority, Listen, America!, `text(1980)`.

We must reverse the trend America finds herself in today. Young people between the ages of `text(twenty-five)` and `text(forty)` have been born and reared in a different world than Americans of `text(years)` past. The television set has been their primary baby-sitter. From the television set they have learned situation ethics and immorality — they have learned a loss of respect for human life. They have learned to disrespect the family as God has established it. They have been educated in a public-school system that is permeated with secular humanism. They have been taught that the Bible is just another book of literature. They have been taught that there are no absolutes in our world today. They have been introduced to the drug culture. They have been reared by the family and the public school in a society that is greatly void of discipline and character-building. These same young people have been reared under the influence of a government that has taught them socialism and welfarism. They have been taught to believe that the world owes them a living whether they work or not.
